Name: Unique Gift Dialogues Expanded
Author: PrincessFelicie
Description:
With the arrival of 1.6, it is now possible for townies to have unique reactions to being gifted specific items. However, most of these reactions are concentrated on rare items added in 1.6, and on romanceable characters. For example, in the base game (and discounting Stardrop Tea), Abigail has 7 unique reactions, Alex has 11, but Clint only has one, and George none...!

I want to get into modding, and this seemed like a simple enough project to cut my teeth on. The aim of this project is to deepen the pool of gift reactions with canon-friendly additions of my own making.

[center][size=5]At present, this mod adds 180* new lines of dialogue, with more on the way.
[/size][size=2](*As of 2.0)[/size][/center]

[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Mod Menu[/url]﻿ is [b]Recommended [/b]but not necessary.[/size]

For prerelease builds, go on the mod's [url=https://github.com/PrincessFelicie/Unique-Gift-Dialogues-Expanded]Github[/url]﻿, then click on Code, then Download ZIP.
[b]
Feedback - [/b]This mod is currently looking for the following types of feedback:
[list]
[*]Something is broken
[*]Something contains a typo or a grammatical error
[*]Something doesn't feel in character or is poorly written
[*]Missing appropriate expression/portrait variant
[*]Suggestions for lines to add
[/list]
[size=5]Translation Policy
[/size]
